changes.before: Production StartDragOut passes COPY|MOVE; a local CF_HDROP-accepting LINK-only target receives no acceptable effect.
changes.fix: Advertise COPY|MOVE|LINK; existing MOVE-only refresh branch remains unchanged.
changes.verification: Private StartDragOut dependency replacement builds a production FileDataObject and invokes a local IDropTarget LINK-only decision; source fixture.pdf and snapshot are preserved.
changes.limits: No actual third-party PDF/editor OLE drag loop. Original issue body could not be re-fetched: GitHub web returned no readable result and REST request had TLS failure; original audit title/evidence and the local production defect are the scope.

changes.before: Recycle divider drag and double-click update the ordinary details array while rendering uses search_column_dividers; normal search is a passing control.
changes.fix: Use the rendered pane is_search flag for drag and autofit.
changes.verification: Production down/move/up and double-click on Recycle and search headers; rendered Size width changes and the rendered stored width resets.

changes.before: Filled Medium/Large grid cell edges enter the file-drag path.
changes.fix: Reserve a 4-DIP gutter inside grid cell edges in ViewLayout::HitTest.
changes.verification: Production pointer down on both gutters starts marqueePending without dragPending; icon centers remain selectable.
changes.limits: Synthetic hidden-window events at 1000x700, 100%; no physical pointer or full marquee motion acceptance.

changes.before: Same-position repeated clicks in a 194-character/220px edit move the caret 182 to 174 and hide the trailing END.txt.
changes.fix: Retain the edit viewport scroll by HWND/text and move it only when the caret exits the visible range; honor externally changed selection endpoints.
changes.verification: Production LumaText mouse path keeps caret 182 to 182; rendered after-click preview retains END.txt.
changes.limits: No real Microsoft Pinyin composition or long selection-drag acceptance.

changes.before: A network-only pinned row has no sidebar context menu.
changes.fix: Offer Open and localized Unpin; re-find the pin after the modal menu and remove only that catalog row, then save.
changes.verification: Production sidebar hit/right-click plus native FluentMenu keyboard cancellation and Unpin; cancel preserves the fixture pin and choosing Unpin removes it.
changes.limits: Invented UNC, persistence disabled. Real SMB reachability/credentials and index-root removal are outside this sidebar-pin correction.

changes.before: Final Size outer edge is not hit as a divider and its resize index is rejected.
changes.fix: Expose the final divider, calculate its true total-width edge, allow final metadata resize/autofit, and track pointer deltas so repeated moves are applied once.
changes.verification: Outer-edge production hit and resize; three production mouse moves shrink Size by exactly 30px, with the flexible Name column absorbing the space.
changes.limits: Hidden-window synthetic mouse messages; no physical drag or DPI matrix.

changes.before: At 184px drive text is silently word-trimmed to External without an ellipsis; 320px is complete.
changes.fix: Use a single-line native DirectWrite name layout with the existing ellipsis sign.
changes.verification: Production DrawDriveSidebarItem 184px/320px render compared visually; narrow label now has ellipsis, wide label and 72% remain intact.
changes.limits: Light theme, 100% DPI only. Long names can still omit the trailing drive letter, visibly indicated by ellipsis.

test_seams: The private app_input.cpp build replaces GetKeyState for VK_LBUTTON only to hold the synthetic button during WM_MOUSEMOVE. No global input is injected.
The private app_input.cpp build replaces DoFileDragDrop with a local CF_HDROP/IDropTarget capability check; no external application is invoked.
All other final executable objects come from the unified production pulse build.
intermediate_harness_limits: During concurrent edits, mixing old shared objects with new AppState/Tab layouts caused access/heap failures before checks; these are invalid fixture prerequisites, not reported product regressions.
A later private link ran while the unified build was replacing dependency objects and failed with missing new symbols; final evidence uses the completed unified build.
The first Unpin test used unsupported VK_END, then an incorrect default-hover assumption; the fixture now explicitly starts with no hovered item and uses Down twice, Return.
system_state: Only isolated workspace fixtures and nonpersistent in-memory places/preferences are used; no user preferences, real source files, recycle bin, or deployment is modified.
